input: Deep condition and trim my natural hair monthly

gold.taskTitle: Deep Condition and Trim Natural Hair Monthly
gold.taskDescription: Establish a consistent monthly routine to deep condition and trim natural hair.

questions.title: What is your current natural hair length and texture?
questions.description: Understanding hair length and texture helps tailor the deep conditioning and trimming routine appropriately.

questions.title: Do you plan to do this at home or at a salon?
questions.description: Knowing the setting determines what tools, products, and steps need to be planned for.

questions.title: Which deep conditioner product do you currently use or prefer?
questions.description: Identifying the preferred product ensures the plan includes the right materials and application steps.

questions.title: How much time can you set aside each session?
questions.description: Session duration affects how the routine is structured, especially deep conditioning processing time.

questions.title: Which specific day of the month works best for you?
questions.description: Pinning down a recurring day helps create a reliable, calendar-based reminder system.

questions.title: Are you trimming your own hair or having someone help?
questions.description: This determines whether the plan needs to include self-trimming techniques or coordinating with another person.

questions.title: What is your main goal, retaining length or removing damage?
questions.description: The primary goal shapes how much is trimmed each session and how the deep conditioning treatment is chosen.
